chunks.title: Bhindi_ka_thecha_chatpata
chunks.text: Hello guys, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen. Today I am going to make Bhindi Pecha. If you like my recipe, please like and subscribe to my channel. For that, first of all, I have washed and dried 300 grams of okra. And for this, I have taken some ingredients. I have taken a little less than a bowl of vermicelli. I have taken a bunch of garlic. Garlic buds. And I have taken 9-10 green chilies. You can add chilies according to your taste. Now let's start. First of all, we will roast it in the pan. First of all, we have kept the pan to heat. And we will roast it. It is hot. We will roast the peanuts. We will roast it well. We will roast it on medium flame. So that it gets roasted well. You can see the color has come. Now we will remove it. After it cools down, we will remove the skin. After that, we will roast the garlic and chili. We have cut the garlic and chili into two pieces. So that it gets roasted well. We will roast it well. You can see that it is roasted like this. The spots have come out well. Now we will remove it. After all three have cooled down. We will grind it coarsely. We don't have to make a fine paste. We have to grind it coarsely. Now we will grind it coarsely. We have ground it coarsely. Now we will fry the okra. Now we will add oil to it. Oil will get heated. Now we will add half a spoon of cumin seeds to it. We will let the cumin seeds crackle. The flavor should come out well. We will add half a spoon of carom seeds to it. It is good for digestion and tastes good too. Now we will add one chopped onion. We will fry it. The onion has become translucent. Now we will add okra to it. I have changed the pan. The quantity of okra was more. And we have roasted it a little. Now we will add half a spoon of turmeric powder to it. We will add salt a little later. And we will roast it well. Okra is soft. That's why we will add one spoon of roasted gram flour to it. You can also add roasted gram flour to it. So that it's softness is removed. And we will stir it well. Now we will add the ground masala to it. And we will stir it well. We will add two pinches of asafoetida to it. It will give a good digestion. It is a very healthy food. And we will stir it well. Now we will add salt to it. I am adding half a spoon of black salt to it. And half a spoon of white salt to it. Both of them. It gives a good flavor. And we will stir it well. Then we will put a lid on it. And we will let it cook for a while. Then we will put a lid on it. We will let it cook for 4-5 minutes on a low flame. 5 minutes. Our okra is ready. We will put it in a plate. And we will serve it. Okra thecha is ready. Thanks for watching. Please subscribe to my channel.
